source.dataset: Nomenclator Geografico de Municipios y Entidades de Poblacion (NGMEP)

key.rule: First five digits of the eleven-digit COD_INE (province + municipality); the remaining six are 000000 on municipality rows.

coordinates.crs: ETRS89 (Peninsula and Balearic Islands) and REGCAN95 (Canary Islands); both are WGS84-compatible and are used as WGS84 for display
coordinates.semantics: Reference point of the municipality as published by the IGN: a point placed as centrally as possible inside the municipality's main population nucleus. It is not the centroid of the municipal territory and not an administrative boundary.
